author: Ottafr
quote: e f*** is this? A cuckold simulator? Jesusss, it’s like playing The Sims, only 20 years later... except you’re on a predetermined path. Take this out, bring that in, sweep the floor. Terrible missions, terrible plot. you’ll want to f** ki*ll the main character after just two seconds of playing. This is yet another game ruined by I don’t know what… modern women? An attempt to make it a recreational game for everyone? Political correctness? I have no idea. An unpalatable, irritating game that destroys everything the previous titles built up. Unfortunately, I can’t return the product anymore because I’ve exceeded the playtime limit.
